notes_status_off: Notes are off. Nothing is loaded until you switch them on.
notes_status_zoom_in: Zoom in to see the notes (from zoom {zoom}).
notes_truncated_panel: This area has more notes than one request gives. Zoom in to see all of them.
notes_truncated_toast: Only the first {limit} notes of this area are shown. Zoom in to see all.
notes_failure_paused: The OpenStreetMap server asked for a pause. The notes load again when it ends.
notes_failure_http: The notes could not be loaded (HTTP {status}).
notes_failure: The notes could not be loaded.
notes_write_later: Writing notes comes with the login.
notes_dock_none: No note chosen. Pick one in the Notes panel or on the map.
